evento.whatIs: The Latin America Technology Conference (LTC) is the region’s leading enterprise summit on Agentic AI. In its 3rd edition, DIGEVO, NVIDIA and Oracle bring together 700+ leaders at Hotel W Santiago to move from theory to real AI ROI.
evento.intro: A full day at the Hotel W Convention Center: strategy in the morning and Training Labs in the afternoon.
learnings: Morning (8:30–12:50): keynotes, panels and business vision with NVIDIA, Oracle and regional leaders.
Afternoon: hands-on technical workshops and certifications with the NVIDIA/Oracle stack.
Networking across the DIGEVO ecosystem and real ROI cases in LATAM.
evento.dateNote: Convention Center · Hotel W Santiago · Isidora Goyenechea 3000, Las Condes.
evento.accessNote: Tell us if you prefer business vision, technical workshops, or both. Your invitation arrives within 24 hours.
evento.partnerNote: Xinergy, a DIGEVO partner, is extending this invitation. Xinergy is not a sponsor of LTC 2026. digevo.com

almuerzo.whatIs: While LTC 2026 — DIGEVO, NVIDIA and Oracle’s agentic AI summit — unfolds at Hotel W, Xinergy opens a reserved table for C-Level leaders at Karai by Mitsuharu: high-caliber conversation, no stage, no pitch.
almuerzo.intro: A private lunch for those who lead strategy: judgment, vision and peer conversation in an intimate, selective format.
highlights: An intimate gathering of C-Level leaders on strategy, technology and decisions that move the business.
Karai by Mitsuharu: high-end Nikkei cuisine at Hotel W Santiago.
Only 20 places. Personal invitation; confirmation subject to availability.
almuerzo.contextNote: Once registered, you will receive the formal invitation within the next 24 hours.
almuerzo.partnerNote: This lunch is a Xinergy invitation. LTC is a DIGEVO and NVIDIA event; Xinergy acts as a DIGEVO partner, not as a conference sponsor.
